description: Infer skills from actual work instead of credentials.
notes: Kit fallback inlined; shared kit.js not present at build time

notes.note: Resumes are unverified claims — true. But LinkedIn owns the professional graph, and 'verification via GitHub/API artifact checks' is thin; anyone can fake a repo contribution. $199/mo employer seats put you in HR-tech's most crowded, most skeptical buying center. The trust signal is the whole product and it's the weakest part.

notes.change: skill graph (17 nodes in one layer, viewBox 3610 wide) was squeezed to ~14% scale, an unreadable smear; gave the svg a 1400px min-width so it scrolls horizontally at readable size

notes.note: Add-work modal verified; zero errors. Fixed header overlap.

notes.change: Hero gained 'Export skill report (.md)' — downloads a Markdown dossier of every skill with confidence %, evidence bullets, and source roles; the artifact you'd send a recruiter. Verified via Playwright download.
